description: Turn a script with several speakers into one audio file, a different FreeTTS voice per speaker, with a pause between lines. Write each line as 'Name: text'. Use it for two-host shows, interviews, scenes, language lessons with two speakers. Needs a connected FreeTTS PRO account.

language.description: Language of the lines when no voices are given.

pause_ms.description: Silence between lines in milliseconds. Default 600.

script.description: Lines like 'Abd: Tonight we cook shakshuka.' one per line. Names before the colon.

voices.description: Speaker name to FreeTTS voice id, like {"Abd": "en-US-AndrewNeural", "Guest": "en-US-EmmaNeural"}. Unnamed speakers get a voice each.

name: dialogue_to_speech

file.description: The same audio as a file.

download_url.description: Where the file can be downloaded.

file_name.description: A name for the file, made from its first words.

title: Dialogue to speech (two or more voices)
